# The RT64 shaders the web page builds before the game starts: one shader description a line, other mode L and H,
# color combiner L and H, flags, in hex. RT64 specializes each one's WGSL when the page is built and compiles them
# all while the page shows "Preparing graphics", so no scene waits on a shader and none draws with the ubershader,
# which integrated graphics can't afford (N64Recomp-browser's README, "Give RT64 a list of the game's shaders").
#
# Recorded from the page opened with ?record-shaders, which prints every description RT64 meets, at the page's
# default settings, in headless Chrome: the intro outside and inside the bar, the bar's menus (GAME1, MULTI,
# OPTIONS, CHAPTERS), Hungover from the chapter menu, a new game's opening cutscene through to Conker walking in the
# field, the pause menu, and seven of the multiplayer modes, one player against bots, about a minute each (Raptor
# among them). Not yet: any chapter after Hungover, the Options screens, split screen (needs a second controller).
# A description missing here draws with the ubershader until its shader is built, as before. Flags follow settings
# (filtering, HDR, MSAA, upscaling), so a change to one of those defaults means recording again.
